title: RubRIX: Rubric-Driven Risk Mitigation in Caregiver-AI Interactions
abstract: arXiv:2601.13235v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Caregivers seeking AI-mediated support express complex needs---information-seeking, emotional validation, and distress cues---that warrant careful evaluation of response safety and appropriateness. Existing AI evaluation frameworks, primarily focused on general risks (toxicity, hallucinations, policy violations, etc), may not adequately capture the nuanced risks of LLM-responses in caregiving-contexts. We introduce RubRIX (Rubric-based Risk Index), a theory-driven, clinician-validated framework for evaluating risks in LLM caregiving responses. Grounded in the Elements of an Ethic of Care, RubRIX operationalizes five empirically-derived risk dimensions: Inattention, Bias & Stigma, Information Inaccuracy, Uncritical Affirmation, and Epistemic Arrogance. translated_title: RubRIX：基于评分量表的照护者-AI交互风险缓解框架
translated_abstract: 寻求AI介导支持的照护者往往表达出复杂的需求——包括信息获取、情感确认以及痛苦信号——这需要对回应的安全性与恰当性进行细致评估。现有的AI评估框架主要聚焦于一般性风险（如毒性、幻觉、政策违规等），可能无法充分捕捉大语言模型回应在照护情境中的细微风险。我们提出了RubRIX（基于评分量表的风险指数），这是一个理论驱动、经临床医生验证的框架，用于评估LLM照护回应中的风险。RubRIX以“关怀伦理要素”为理论基础，将五个经实证得出的风险维度进行操作化：忽视、偏见与污名化、信息不准确、不加批判的肯定，以及认知傲慢。我们在来自Reddit和ALZConnected的超过20,000条照护者查询上评估了六个最先进的LLM。经过评分量表引导的改进，风险成分持续降低了45-98%……
tldr: 本文提出了RubRIX——一个基于关怀伦理理论、经临床医生验证的评分量表框架，将LLM在照护者交互场景中的回应风险操作化为五个维度，并在超过2万条真实照护者查询上验证，量表引导的改进可将风险成分降低45-98%。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces RubRIX, a theory-driven, clinician-validated rubric framework grounded in the Ethic of Care that operationalizes five risk dimensions for evaluating LLM caregiving responses, demonstrating that rubric-guided refinement reduces risk components by 45-98% across over 20,000 real caregiver queries.
